name: Ulvestad Variation — Black Tactics
description: 4 tactical challenges for Black in the Ulvestad Variation. Find the precise counter-attacking sequences to press Black's initiative, keep the knights active, and fight for compensation against White's central control.

drills.name: Nd4 Central Outpost
drills.description: Black to play. After 7.c3, take 7...Nxd5 — White deviates with 8.cxd4 instead of 8.Ne4.
drills.explanation: Black to move. No forced tactic exists here, but Bf1 is clearly the strongest continuation. Line: 1. Bf1 Nd4 2. c3 Nxd5 3. cxd4. Stockfish 18 (depth 16) evaluates the result at +0.27 for Black, 0.35 pawns better than the next-best alternative.

drills.name: cxd4 and the d3 Wedge
drills.description: White to play. Open the center, then clamp it shut with a d3 pawn wedge.
drills.briefExplanation: cxd4 exd4 d3! fixes Black’s pawns and leaves White with the superior structure.
drills.explanation: Black to move. There is a real tactic here: cxd4 winning material. Line: 1. cxd4 exd4 2. d3 Bb4+ 3. Bd2. Stockfish 18 (depth 16) evaluates the result at +1.58 for Black, 2.30 pawns better than the next-best alternative.
drills.placementNote: Standalone position — does not arise from the Ulvestad Variation main line.
